English: Spirit Post
A simple wooden post adorned with small tokens and offerings, marking the first attempt to honor the Magyar ancestors on the steppe frontier.
Prayer Stand
A crude prayer stand of stones and carved wood, where the clan gathers to make offerings and recite ancestral prayers.
Ancestor Hut
A sturdy felt-and-wood hut, housing sacred relics of the ancestors and serving as a place for private devotion and memory.
Worship Pavilion
A large, decorated tent-pavilion where the clan gathers for major ancestor rites and unifying ceremonies.
Sanctified Room
A dedicated room, constructed within a large yurt or wooden structure, sanctified for ritual ancestor worship and clan councils.
Priests Hall
A solid wooden hall where priestly keepers of the ancestors reside, preserving tradition and offering guidance to the clan.
Blessed Glade
A sacred grove where trees are adorned with ribbons and offerings, believed to be watched over by the clans founding spirits.
Diviners Chamber
A chamber set aside for the clans diviners to commune with the ancestors, interpret omens, and lead the people in spiritual unity.
Shrine Hall
A grand hall of wood and stone, richly adorned with ancestral symbols, serving as the spiritual heart of the Magyar clan.
Magyar Sanctuary
The most sacred structure of the Magyar people, a fortified sanctuary where the ancestors’ spirits are honored with great ceremony, uniting the clan and inspiring all.
